bcd.A: Not trained: no verified narrative-only supervision.
bcd.B: Narrative + question/candidate table-text embeddings; no image.
bcd.C: Same text + identical local/row/global ViT views using concatenation.
bcd.D: Same text and images, with attention over the three visual views and a learned sigmoid gate.

boundaries: All original splits were previously exposed. Historical Test is not an untouched holdout.
Five seeds vary option presentation, not model training; the same 788 questions are repeated.
Original labels and known source/period/scope defects are retained. No answer correction or numeric-rule fallback.
Native and reduced-image arms are not compute matched. Both use the same Qwen processor bounds; reduced images may be upsampled.
Saved responses were checked, not regenerated. Full prompt/grid/token/runtime archive audit is verified only for order seed 11.
Qwen results do not establish a gain for the FinBERT/ViT model or a causal advantage of fusion.
